2. Bidding high enough to have a reasonable chance of winning
3. Recognizing this is a one-shot game with no repeated learning

A strategic approach is to bid slightly below my true value, around $22-$23, which gives me potential profit margin if I win while not overpaying.

I'll bid $2.50 to create some buffer between my value and bid, hoping to exit early if competition is strong while preserving potential profit margin.
